For leaders

Teacher tools

Each game has six versions. Cases are assigned at random. The first time a student begins a game on a device, the game picks one of the six and keeps it. Students do not choose their case, and the game never shows them which one they have.

  • Two students who sit together can get the same case by chance.
  • The case stays the same after a reload, after starting over, and when a save file is exported and imported.
  • Only “Erase my progress” in a game’s settings, or clearing the browser’s site data, picks a new one.

Leader preview

These links open a case in a labeled preview with a throwaway save. A preview never changes a student’s game or assigned case. Do not share these links with students.
